resources.string: Only selected copies move to the recycle bin.
Marked originals stay. Files are rechecked; unsafe copies are skipped.
You can restore them from the recycle bin.
The items will leave their current album.
They will move to the selected destination.
Creates copies in the selected destination.
The source files stay in their current album.
Removes all thumbnail cache directories to free up storage.
Thumbnails will be decoded again the next time you open them.
Removes the saved %1$s index for this image.
Future uncached tiles will use the standard decoder again.
Named .%1$s, but detected as %2$s. It will be indexed as %2$s.
Named .%1$s, but the actual content is %2$s.
You can still view the image normally. A zoom index cannot be built for this format yet.
Allow notification access in Android settings to enable background support.
Reads the complete JPEG once to create a seek index for this image at every zoom level.
It may briefly use significant power.
Decodes the complete PNG once and builds a lossless multi-resolution tile index.
It may temporarily use significant power and storage.
Validates and activates existing TIFF tiles, strips, and reduced-resolution directories.
The full image is not decoded or duplicated.
Decodes the complete static WebP once and builds a lossless multi-resolution tile index.
Animated WebP is not changed or indexed.
Develops the complete camera RAW once with camera white balance and builds a lossless sRGB tile pyramid.
The original RAW is never changed.
Reads bounded HEIF/AVIF regions once and builds a lossless tile pyramid.
The complete decoded image is never held in memory.
Validates the uncompressed BMP row layout and writes a 56-byte activation.
Later zoom reads only scan lines crossing the viewport.
Streams the complete still JPEG XL once and builds a lossless sRGB multi-resolution tile index without holding the complete image in memory.
Animated and HDR JPEG XL are not indexed yet.
